observations: Torah #106 is a single-sentence teaching stating that one should think Torah thoughts during marital relations, and that doing so will not prevent having children. The text contains no bechina language and no conceptual equivalence mappings. The concepts mentioned (הרהורי תורה, זיווג, בנים) are presented in a straightforward practical/halachic statement, not as a web of interconnected aspects. There is no basis for proposing any bechina-based packages.
